display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 为防范金融犯罪风险,所实施的政策、控制措施和程序必须:

options.A: 与企业的规模和性质相称,经高级管理层批准,并定期审查
options.B: 仅由第一道防线创建、批准和拥有,并每年进行审查
options.C: 由业务部门完成并由外部公司进行验证
options.D: 采用最新的可用技术,纳入复杂且自动化的控制措施

stem_en: In order to prevent financial crime risk, the implemented policies, controls, and procedures must:

options_en.A: Be proportionate to the size and nature of the firm, approved by senior management, and regularly reviewed
options_en.B: Be created, approved, and owned only by the first line of defense and reviewed annually
options_en.C: Be completed by the business and validated by an external firm
options_en.D: Include sophisticated and automated controls using the newest available technologies
